name: Survey tile in Aquarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.4 degrees south of the ecliptic in Aquarius, imaged by SPHEREx 14 times in 4 visits over 28 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 28 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 28 hours starting 2026-05-18, at wavelengths from 0.80 to 4.92 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
